springs: stiffness damping, mass 1, from Design Bookmark's shared/tokens.css: pop 520 16, settle 280 22, soft 260 24, fade 420 32; bites 700 22, wobble 190 9, height 230 22, tick 160 20. Reduced motion: each spring critically damped (damping = 2·√stiffness) and no crumbs.

Your visit counts', tick draws (160/20) from +0.28 s; note fades and drops 8 px (fade 420/32) at +2.4 s; banner removed

interactions.effect: store consent 'no'; nothing loads; the cookie rolls off the left of the card (velocity -60, accel -620 px/s²) and drops (1500 px/s²); at 0.8 s the card folds into 'Not counted · change it in About'; note goes at +2.4 s; banner removed
interactions.reduced_motion: springs critically damped; the cookie still rolls off
